end.summary:
Practised choosing exact versus approximate values in everyday situations.
Rounded numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore.
Compared rounding thresholds and judged the size of rounding errors.
Worked through lakh/crore place-value and halfway-point examples; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ayaan practised deciding when an exact value is needed, such as for an online school fee, and when an estimate is suitable. They used the halfway point to round numbers and calculated the difference between an actual and rounded value. There was a brief mix-up with lakh/crore place values and rounding thresholds, which was corrected while working through later examples. At home, ask Ayaan to round two household or shopping totals to the nearest thousand and explain the possible error.
